item.title: Big increase in visitors to free Museum – but uncertainty over future funding
item.description: THERE has been a significant increase in the number of visitors to the Museum since entry became free in July 2024 – although it remains uncertain if the government-funded service will continue. item.title: Getting over the overhang: bus station redesign to stop double-decker crashes
item.description: THE entrance to Liberation Station will be fitted with a height-restriction barrier and the paving realigned to stop double-decker buses hitting the overhanging building, as has happened three times in the past, if Planning agree. item.description: PORTS of Jersey’s plan to remove the ageing and weathered landing stage at the end of Gorey Pier “remains on track” subject to planning approval. item.description: CONCERNS over fairness, prejudice and an already “creaking” court system have resurfaced following fresh calls to reintroduce retrials in Jersey following hung juries.
